content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 The RTE Generator shall call all Rte_Rips_NotifyTxTOut Services from the Rte_COMCbkTxTOut callback respectively for Communication Graph s where • Tx signals are configured AND • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794].
